name: Rowing Ergometer Style Pull

instructions.description: Sit tall on the floor with legs extended or slightly bent and loop a resistance band around your feet.
Hold the band ends and begin with arms extended and shoulders relaxed.
Drive the elbows back while squeezing the shoulder blades and simultaneously press the feet gently into the band to create full-body tension.
Return slowly to the start and repeat rhythmically for the planned interval.

variations.variationDescription: A lighter rhythmic pulling variation emphasizing endurance rather than maximal strength.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Slow the tempo and perform set repetitions for strength emphasis.

commentsNotes: Keep the spine long instead of rounding.
Use a securely anchored band position.
